What SmartShield changes

From friction to intelligent intervention.

Before SmartShield

One unusual purchase creates a dead end.

  1. Good customer makes an unusual purchase
  2. Transaction is declined
  3. Customer calls the fraud department
  4. Card restrictions are reviewed
  5. Customer waits for access
→Less friction

With SmartShield

The customer gets a clear next action.

  1. Good customer makes an unusual purchase
  2. Multiple signals are analyzed
  3. SmartShield requests in-app verification
  4. Customer confirms the purchase
  5. Payment continues securely

Responsible prototype

What this demonstration assumes

Trust starts with being explicit about what the prototype can—and cannot—show.

!

Current limitations

  • Uses synthetic transactions and transparent rules, not a production fraud model.
  • Has no live payment-network, authorization, issuer, or wallet connection.
  • Requires model validation, security review, governance, and regulatory controls before production use.
?

Key assumptions

  • Customers can access and authenticate through the Northstar Bank mobile experience.
  • Relevant device, merchant, location, and network signals are available and governed.
  • Customers can receive and respond to verification requests.
  • Digital-payment continuity would use appropriate eligibility, authentication, and provisioning controls.

Demo environment · Synthetic data only · No real customer information
